Summaries.eng: New-Port City has a problem with crime, and in order to combat this the mayor orders the creation of a new police unit: THE TANK POLICE! Trouble ensues when the feisty Leona is transferred in from the motorcycle-division and has a little problem getting used to the tanks (i.e.: how to drive them without demolishing building.), and accidentally destroys the personal tank of the units commander, Lt. Britain. Threatened with re-assignment to child-welfare, Leona builds, with the help of Al and the Chaplain, a new smaller tank out of spare parts. The new tank, christened Bonaparte by Leona, is finished just in time to stop Crime-Lord Buaku and his henchwomen, Annapuna and Unipima (aka, the Cat Sisters), from steeling urine from people who are un-effected by the poison cloud that hangs over the entire planet. Finally accepted into the Tank Police, Leona ends up causing as much, if not more, trouble then the others ever did
Summaries.jpn: 『ドミニオン』（英語: DOMINION）は、士郎正宗による漫画作品、および左記を原作としたアニメーション作品。近未来の日本を舞台に、「警察戦車隊」の女性隊員レオナと愛機の小型戦車「ボナパルト」の活躍を描く、スラップスティック・コメディ調の作品である。OVAとして3回アニメ化されている。

Aliases: 特捜戦車隊ドミニオン

Summaries.eng:
TANK S.W.A.T is a CGI-animated spinoff from the manga Dominion: Tank Police.

Yuri and Asada are on a mission to retrieve confidential data discs that were stolen from the government, but once they finally track down the items, AI-controlled tanks threaten their lives. It's up to Leona Ozaki's Tank SWAT team to take action! But even if the enemy tanks are destroyed, danger still exists in the form of a mysterious android that has taken Asada hostage and fitted her with a bomb collar. Leona must make a choice: does she risk losing the data discs and the lives of the rest of her team for the life of a single team mate?

New-Port City has a problem with crime, and in order to combat it, the mayor orders the creation of a new police unit: the Tank Police! Trouble ensues when the feisty Leona Ozaki is transferred in from the motorcycle-division, and has a little problem getting used to the tanks — in particular how to drive them without demolishing buildings — and accidentally destroys the personal tank of the unit's commander, Lt. Brenten. Threatened with reassignment to child-welfare, Leona builds a new smaller tank out of spare parts, with the help of Al and the Chaplain.

The new tank, christened Bonaparte by Leona, is finished just in time to stop crime lord Buaku and his henchwomen, Anna Puma and Yuni Puma (aka the Cat Sisters), from stealing urine from people who are unaffected by the poison cloud that hangs over the entire planet. Finally accepted into the Tank Police, Leona ends up causing as much, if not more, trouble than the rest of the team ever did.
Summaries.jpn:
1988年 - 1989年、エイジェント21制作。

原作第1期の前日譚にあたり、レオナの戦車隊入隊、ボナパルト製作の経緯、武悪やグリンピースの誕生経緯が描かれる。

この作品は、1991年2月22日から同年3月29日までテレビ東京で放送されていた。放送時間は毎週金曜 18:30 - 19:00 （日本標準時）。
Summaries.fra:
Saviez-vous qu'en 2100, la Terre était entourée par un nuage bactériologique si toxique que la population était forcée de se protéger ?
Unipuma et Annapuna, deux « nekogirls » sexy et sans pitié, s'allient au grotesque Buaku afin de voler les flacons d'urines des rares personnes non empoisonnées par l'atmosphère extérieure.

Summaries.eng: A futuristic world is kept under control by a force known as the Tank Police. However, when the evil, attractive female members of the Bauku Gang threaten to take over, it is up to the Tank Police to stop them.

The Buaku Gang, with its machine-gun toting, cleavage-bearing Cat Sisters, is at it again. This time, as the Tank Police pours after them, Buaku unleashes his new secret weapon that he's sure will stop the tanks in their tracks.
A priceless painting is stolen by the Bauku Gang, and it is up to the Tank Police to reclaim it before the sinister Red Commandos find it.
The Tank Police discover the origins of the Bauku while attempting to hold off the Red Commandos.

Titles.jpn: 特捜戦車隊ドミニオン

Summaries.eng: Kobe, Japan in the year 2100 AD is made a lot less safe by Leona, her tank Bonaparte and the Puma sisters Anna and Yuni. With terrorism a constant threat in the ruins of Newport City, the newly formed Tank Police tries to regain control of the increasingly lawless city.
Summaries.jpn: 近未来。人間と区別がつかないほどのアンドロイドも開発可能なこの時代、武装した犯罪組織に対抗するために、警察には戦車隊という組織が結成されていた。兵庫警察ニューポート署のタンクポリス課に所属するレオナ・オザキは、隊員中では唯一の女性でありながら、豆戦車のボナパルトを駆り、相棒のアルとともに日々悪人退治に励むのだった。士郎正宗原作で、カーチェイスやガンアクションが満載なポリスアクションの二度目のアニメ化作品！
Summaries.fra: Un tank Araignée terrorise Newport City. Ridiculisée, la Tank police essaie maladroitement de faire face au danger. Cette fois-ci, ce n'est pas un bandit idéaliste et débonnaire qui menace le fragile équilibre de la mégalopole, mais une corporation tentaculaire et impitoyable. De retour sur le devant de la scène, Leona, Brenten, Bonaparte et les sœurs Puma, "toujours sexy", rivalisent de fantaisie et d'excentricité pour combattre un ennemi déterminé qui maîtrise parfaitement les derniers chefs-d'œuvre de la technologie...

Titles.jpn: VOL.1  出撃！タンクポリス!!

Summaries.eng: Leona is causing the usual ruckus, destroying an entire city block to catch on criminal. As her teams gets yet another berating from the bumbling and high-pressured police chief, a jackass of an observer shows up.
Summaries.jpn: 細菌雲が空に重く立ちこめる近未来。ニューポート分署タンクポリス課の婦警レオナは相棒のアルと豆戦車ボナパルトを駆り、悪人退治に励んでいた。そんなある夜、現場に急行中の二人は謎のクモ型機動兵器と遭遇する。

Titles.jpn: VOL.2  名探偵チャールズ・ブレンテン!!〜N.P.の黒い雨〜

Summaries.eng: An old friend of Leona's is mysteriously killed. Bent on revenge, little Leona takes a leave of absence to hunt down the murderer. Somehow the mayor and the chief never realized that Leona is least suitable member for any kind of undercover or vaguely subtle work!
Summaries.jpn: レオナの白バイ隊時代の同僚・シャロンが殺害された。レオナは署長に休職届けを叩き付け、単独捜査を開始する。アルは彼女に多国籍企業・大日本技研と事件の関連を教えるが、そこにはドス黒い罠が待ち受けていた…！

Titles.jpn: VOL.3  リミット・ザ・チューブウェイ

Summaries.eng: A gigantic automated truck filled with explosives races straight for the center of the city, running over everything in its path.
Summaries.jpn: 放射性物質を満載したトレーラーが、何者かに乗っ取られた！ このまま市内で爆発すれば、ニューポートの街は廃墟と化してしまう…。AIに制御され、防弾装備を施されたトレーラーを止められるのはタンクポリスのみだ！

Titles.jpn: VOL.4  追跡!?霧の中のボナパルト

Summaries.eng: Leona's dear Bonaparte gets stolen and in tracking it down, Leona finds out that it was taken by the Puma Sisters because a researcher had hidden some top-secret data about new virtual narcotics in the tank.
Summaries.jpn: ボナパルトが盗まれた〜！ 犯人は双子のアンドロイド・アンナプーマとユニプーマ。レオナとアルは愛車を追って細菌雲立ちこめる中へ飛び出して行く。影に見え隠れする違法バーチャルドラッグ密売…その黒幕の正体は？

Titles.jpn: VOL.5  コンフリクト・シティ

Summaries.eng: Another version of the spider-vehicle attacks a prison, breaking out the killer of Leona's friend. That is followed by a string of red-herrings and false alarms for terrorist attacks. The Tank Police are, of course, mobilized and spread rather thin.
Summaries.jpn: ニューポートシティでは武装テロ事件が頻発していた。駆けつけるタンクポリス課隊員をあざ笑うかのように、痕跡も残さず、事件現場から忽然と姿を消す犯人たち。そしてついにテロの魔手は、ウェザビー市長の身に…！

Titles.jpn: VOL.6  エンド・ザ・ドリーミング

Summaries.eng: The traitor finds out that the mayor is still alive. He was planning to defect to another evil mega-corporation and killing the mayor was kinda part of the deal. Two more spider-bots are sent out to attack the hospital where the mayor is being treated.
Summaries.jpn: 重傷を負わされた市長は、警察病院へ搬送された。警護するブレンテンたちの前に、三たび現れる機動兵器。一方、レオナは全ての事件を結びつける人物の正体をつかみかけていた。果たして最後に勝つのは正義か、悪か？
